title: Repulsive normalizing flow mixtures for adaptive importance sampling: reliability analysis of complex systems
abstract: arXiv:2609.21160v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Accurate rare-event estimation can be computationally expensive. Classical adaptive importance sampling (IS) schemes often rely on restrictive proposal families and can struggle under multiple failure modes. We propose FAMIS, a flow-based multiple importance sampling (MIS) framework that learns a nonuniform mixture of normalizing flow proposals for rare event estimation. The method does not require presampled failure data or prior knowledge of the number, location, or geometry of the failure modes. Instead, it adaptively learns the mixture through sequential evaluations of the limit state function. To guide training toward the failure domain, FAMIS uses a smooth rare-event surrogate and a tempered target sequence. A defensive exploration mixture improves early-stage coverage, a Rao Blackwellized update adapts the mixture weights, and a Jensen-Shannon repulsion term promotes separation and diversity among the base components. translated_title: 用于自适应重要性抽样的排斥性归一化流混合：复杂系统的可靠性分析
translated_abstract: 精确的稀有事件估计在计算上可能非常昂贵。经典的自适应重要性抽样（IS）方案通常依赖于受限的提议分布族，并且在存在多种失效模式时可能表现不佳。我们提出了FAMIS，一个基于流的多次重要性抽样（MIS）框架，它通过学习归一化流提议的非均匀混合来进行稀有事件估计。该方法不需要预采样的失效数据，也不需要关于失效模式数量、位置或几何形状的先验知识。相反，它通过对极限状态函数的顺序评估来自适应地学习混合分布。为了引导训练朝向失效域，FAMIS使用平滑的稀有事件代理函数和退火的目标序列。防御性探索混合提高了早期阶段的覆盖范围，Rao-Blackwell化更新自适应地调整混合权重，而Jensen-Shannon排斥项促进了基础组件之间的分离和多样性。
tldr: 提出了一种基于归一化流混合的自适应多次重要性抽样框架FAMIS，利用Jensen-Shannon排斥项促进组件多样性，无需失效模式先验知识即可实现复杂系统稀有事件的高效可靠估计。
en_tdlr: FAMIS is a flow-based multiple importance sampling framework that adaptively learns a repulsive mixture of normalizing flow proposals using Jensen-Shannon repulsion, enabling efficient rare event estimation of complex systems without prior knowledge of failure modes.
